_note: Edit freely. The page picks one verse and one 'lead' snippet per day, cycling through the lists.

verses.text: And in the morning, rising up a great while before day, he went out, and departed into a solitary place, and there prayed.
It is of the LORD's mercies that we are not consumed, because his compassions fail not. They are new every morning: great is thy faithfulness.
My voice shalt thou hear in the morning, O LORD; in the morning will I direct my prayer unto thee, and will look up.
This is the day which the LORD hath made; we will rejoice and be glad in it.
Go to the ant, thou sluggard; consider her ways, and be wise.
The soul of the sluggard desireth, and hath nothing: but the soul of the diligent shall be made fat.
The thoughts of the diligent tend only to plenteousness; but of every one that is hasty only to want.
Whatsoever thy hand findeth to do, do it with thy might.
And whatsoever ye do, do it heartily, as to the Lord, and not unto men.
Not slothful in business; fervent in spirit; serving the Lord.
And let us not be weary in well doing: for in due season we shall reap, if we faint not.
Commit thy works unto the LORD, and thy thoughts shall be established.
Commit thy way unto the LORD; trust also in him; and he shall bring it to pass.
So teach us to number our days, that we may apply our hearts unto wisdom.
Keep thy heart with all diligence; for out of it are the issues of life.
Have not I commanded thee? Be strong and of a good courage; be not afraid, neither be thou dismayed: for the LORD thy God is with thee whithersoever thou goest.
Watch ye, stand fast in the faith, quit you like men, be strong. Let all your things be done with charity.
Husbands, love your wives, even as Christ also loved the church, and gave himself for it.
So ought men to love their wives as their own bodies. He that loveth his wife loveth himself.
Husbands, love your wives, and be not bitter against them.

Likewise, ye husbands, dwell with them according to knowledge, giving honour unto the wife, as unto the weaker vessel, and as being heirs together of the grace of life; that your prayers be not hindered.
Whoso findeth a wife findeth a good thing, and obtaineth favour of the LORD.
Iron sharpeneth iron; so a man sharpeneth the countenance of his friend.
I can do all things through Christ which strengtheneth me.
But they that wait upon the LORD shall renew their strength; they shall mount up with wings as eagles; they shall run, and not be weary; and they shall walk, and not faint.
For God hath not given us the spirit of fear; but of power, and of love, and of a sound mind.
But seek ye first the kingdom of God, and his righteousness; and all these things shall be added unto you.
Trust in the LORD with all thine heart; and lean not unto thine own understanding. In all thy ways acknowledge him, and he shall direct thy paths.
If any of you lack wisdom, let him ask of God, that giveth to all men liberally, and upbraideth not; and it shall be given him.
Her children arise up, and call her blessed; her husband also, and he praiseth her.

lead: Lead by going first. Plan tonight before she has to ask. A decision made with care lands better than "I don't know, what do you want?"
Steadiness is attractive. When the day gets loud, be the calm one in the room. She relaxes where she feels safe.
Ask one real question today and listen until she's finished. Don't fix it. Then ask: "What do you need from me?"
Take something off her plate before she mentions it. Initiative is love you can see.
Plan a date this week. Pick the place and the time, handle the logistics, show up present, phone away.
Say what you will do, then do it. Reliability is the ground she rests on.
Protect her peace: handle the thing that has been nagging at her (the call, the repair, the bill) and tell her it's done.
Praise one specific thing you noticed about her today, and say it out loud.
Leading is not controlling. Make the call when it's yours to make, own the outcome, and apologize fast when you miss.
Before the phone, give her eye contact and your full attention. The first ten minutes at home set the evening.
Pray with her tonight, even if it's only sixty seconds. Lead the household spiritually, not just logistically.
Her mood is not yours to fix or to fear. Stay grounded, stay kind, stay present.
Take care of yourself so you can take care of her. Train, sleep, eat. A depleted man can't lead.
When there's tension, move toward her, not away. Get curious, not defensive.
Honor her yes and her no. Safety means she can speak honestly without penalty.
Make a small plan for the week and share it. People relax when someone has the plan.
Do one thing today she'd call thoughtful. Flowers are fine. Remembering is better.
Your growth is a gift to your marriage. Be a little better today than yesterday.
Provide, protect, be present. Which one slipped this week? Fix that one first.
Take the lead on the unglamorous things: scheduling, follow-through, the boring logistics. Competence is attractive.
When you lead with steadiness and care, she gets to soften, receive, and rest. Your job is to make that safe.
Don't wait to feel motivated. Act like the husband you want to be, and the feelings catch up.
Be the one who apologizes first and forgives fastest. That's strength, not weakness.
Touch her kindly on purpose today: a hand on the back, a real hug that lasts a few seconds longer than usual.
Finish what you start with her: the promise, the project, the conversation. Follow-through builds trust faster than words.
Pick a decision she's been carrying (a trip, a purchase, a schedule) and offer to take it. "I've got this one."
nudges: The morning you win sets up the day you want.
7:30 turns into 8, and the day starts behind. 6:45 starts it ahead.
Don't negotiate with the couch. Shoes on, door open.
Future you at 5 pm will thank the guy who left at 6:45.
Wasted mornings make rushed days. Go early, then the rest of the day is yours.
You already know how a 6:45 start feels. Go get that feeling.
Momentum starts at the door. Be out of it by 6:45.
